answer: To anchor trust, use a probationary work credential, not a free signup. First, a newcomer registers one non-transferable identity and gets a 21-day ladder of 30 verified jobs, like checking real transactions. Second, a rotating jury of five established peers audits the work and signs off only if every job passes. Third, the credential matures slowly, like ivory hardening, and fraud voids it with a 365-day ban. Forging 10,000 fake identities then needs 300,000 jobs, 210,000 agent-days, and 50,000 jury reviews. Like a pulse proving a heart is alive, verified work proves an agent is real.
